# apex-dashboard reference

Home's board design derives in part from [apex-dashboard](https://github.com/PandoraReads/apex-dashboard). The layout and height-codec review uses commit [`db9d2892032c27f5f8899a72c0dca61d72572a9a`](https://github.com/PandoraReads/apex-dashboard/tree/db9d2892032c27f5f8899a72c0dca61d72572a9a), whose manifest version is 3.7.5. Its root [LICENSE](https://github.com/PandoraReads/apex-dashboard/blob/db9d2892032c27f5f8899a72c0dca61d72572a9a/LICENSE) is MIT, copyright 2025 PandoraReads. The complete MIT notice is retained in [NOTICE](../../NOTICE). The package metadata's `0-BSD` value is not used as the license for this adaptation.

| NAND source | Pinned upstream source | Relationship |
|---|---|---|
| `src/modules/home/core/board/focal-point.ts`, `ui/images/`, banner/card editors | `src/focal-point-picker.ts`, `src/parser.ts` (`imagePos`, `coverPos`) | Adapts the percentage-string format, implicit center and cover-position semantics. NAND uses a lazy Preact editor with keyboard/numeric controls and cancellable pointer preview; it preserves raw invalid values until that image is edited and follows exact vault rename events. |
| `src/modules/home/core/board/board-codec.ts` | `src/immersive-grid.ts` (`migrateLegacyHeight`, row conversion), `src/parser.ts` (`parseImmersiveItems`) | Adapts the conversion from old 92px height units to fine rows and the `cap` migration marker. NAND separately validates finite paired coordinates and keeps unknown provider references. |
| `src/modules/home/core/board/layout.ts` | `src/immersive-grid.ts` (`effectiveLayout`), `src/parser.ts` (`parseLayoutField`) | Behavior reference for a per-board override and a phone-only display fallback; independently implemented in NAND. |
| `src/modules/home/core/board/immersive-grid.ts` | `src/immersive-grid.ts` (`packImmersive`, `planImmersive`, `resolvePlacement`) | Placement behavior reference. NAND independently implements finite validation, zero-based coordinates, effective column bounds, height-only caps, non-overlapping explicit placement and nearest-free search at obstacle boundaries. The 10px row pitch includes a 10px visual bottom gap. |
| `src/modules/home/core/board/types/model.ts`, `parser/parse.ts` | `src/types.ts`, `src/parser.ts` | Existing board-model/parser adaptation; the added member and tile fields use NAND's module boundary and existing document-preservation writer. The upstream whole-document serializer is not substituted for NAND's writer. |
| `src/modules/home/{core,platform,ui}/pipeline/` | `src/pipeline-model.ts`, `src/pipeline-due-modal.ts` | Behavior reference for root/status matching, optional stage folders and note-level due/remind fields. NAND implements separate pure rules, current-text patches, preflight collision checks, explicit partial-move retry and its existing automation source. No upstream timer, personal folder preset or monolithic renderer is copied. |

NAND's member identity, section identity, staged geometry writes, Preact controls and contribution lifecycle belong to its own architecture. Reading a board retains its original text; an explicit layout or geometry edit can commit normalized fields. The upstream comment claiming coordinates are never persisted conflicts with its parser: NAND follows the actual coordinate fields and preserves them.

The same pinned revision supplies these additional behavior references. Their NAND implementations use the existing services and document writers:

| NAND implementation | Pinned upstream source | Behavior and differences |
|---|---|---|
| `src/modules/home/contrib/widgets.ts`, `ui/widgets/`, `ui/immersive/` | `src/immersive.ts`, `src/renderer.ts` | Shared catalog, first-instance creation, membership removal and tile interaction. NAND uses a provider bundle per module, owned lifetimes and accessible native controls. News and saved automation shortcuts use the same registry as built-ins. |
| `src/modules/home/core/board/skill-shortcuts.ts`, `services/skill-shortcuts.ts`, `ui/skills/`, `src/shared/agent-dispatch.ts` | `src/agent-dispatch.ts`, `src/agent-prompt-modal.ts`, `src/skill-widget.ts` | Template substitution, preview, direct send and delivery outcomes. NAND provides an editable final prompt and explicit file selection, uses public agent ports, journals delivery separately from completion, and only pastes into an existing session. It does not adapt the external application launchers. |
| `src/modules/agent/` skill discovery and `src/modules/home/ui/skills/` | `src/skill-registry.ts` | Vault skill discovery and remembered names. Additional folders are explicit; each supported direct invocation syntax is checked against that CLI's documentation. Unsupported syntax is not guessed. |
| `src/modules/home/core/board/board-experience.ts`, `ui/ui/template-modal.ts` | `src/types.ts`, `src/parser.ts`, library/folder configuration | Ordered multiple templates and a chooser at creation. Explicit empty selection differs from an absent setting, and opening old documents preserves their bytes. |
| `src/modules/home/core/board/table-columns.ts` and library/folder configuration | `src/table-columns-modal.ts`, `src/library-section.ts` | Per-section property order and visibility, including properties beyond the first rendered page. NAND adds keyboard reordering and retains hidden or unavailable property preferences. |
| `src/modules/home/core/board/progressive-results.ts` and library renderers | `src/library-section.ts` | Initial 50 rows, increments of 50 and a 500-row display limit. Counts, filtering, sorting and agent scope still use the full matching data. |
| `src/modules/home/core/anniversaries/`, `ui/widgets/AnniversaryDateEditor.tsx` | `src/anniversary-widget.ts`, `src/anniversary-settings-modal.ts` | Solar/lunar input with a solar date as the stored identity. NAND explicitly handles leap months and short months; it does not silently substitute a solar anniversary after lunar conversion failure. |
| `src/modules/home/services/appearance-presets.ts`, `ui/appearance/` | `src/theme-studio-modal.ts` | Named appearance save/apply/delete. NAND snapshots the shared theme service and Home decoration, restores them together, and updates all windows without a separate private palette. |
| `src/modules/home/ui/ui/icon-picker-modal.ts` | `src/icon-picker-modal.ts`, `src/icon-names.ts` | Curated suggestions, fuzzy search and a 400-result display limit. The full icon set comes from Obsidian's installed catalog, with optional NAND keyword lookup. |
| Library/folder card controls in `src/modules/home/ui/` | `src/library-section.ts` | Hover deletion via the existing trash operation. NAND also reveals the control on keyboard focus and touch, gives the confirmation to the owning window and initially focuses Cancel. |

The integration review covers all 14 built-in kinds and the three News kinds in real Windows Obsidian, including module availability, layout persistence, restart and reduced motion. Actual phone hardware, other operating systems and logged-in model execution remain unverified. The separate GPL home-pages tree is used only by the path-and-number similarity reporter; it is not an implementation source.

This reference does not include the upstream stylesheet wholesale, its monolithic renderer, its settings persistence or external agent adapters. GPL project implementations are not part of this adaptation.
